papers.title: Autoregressive Visual Generation Needs a Prologue
papers.authors: Bowen Zheng, Weijian Luo, Guang Yang, Colin Zhang, Tianyang Hu
papers.affiliations: 1 The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, 2 hi-Lab, Xiaohongshu Inc
papers.intro: 提出Prologue方法，通过在视觉token序列前添加一组独立学习的“序言token”（prologue tokens），使AR模型专注于生成优化而视觉token专用于重建，从而在不牺牲重建质量的前提下显著提升自回归图像生成质量。

papers.title: Dynamic Pondering Sparsity-aware Mixture-of-Experts Transformer for Event Stream based Visual Object Tracking
papers.authors: Shiao Wang, Xiao Wang, Duoqing Yang, Wenhao Zhang, Bo Jiang, Lin Zhu, Yonghong Tian, Bin Luo
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Technology, Anhui University (Shiao Wang, Duoqing Yang, Wenhao Zhang, Xiao Wang, Bo Jiang, Bin Luo); Beijing Institute of Technology (Lin Zhu); Peng Cheng Laboratory, Peking University (Yonghong Tian)
papers.intro: 本文提出PSMTrack，一种动态思考型稀疏感知混合专家Transformer框架，通过多时间尺度层次化特征注入、稀疏感知MoE和自适应推理深度调整，实现事件流跟踪中准确性与计算效率的优越平衡。

papers.title: Uncovering Entity Identity Confusion in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
papers.authors: Shu Wu, Xiaotian Ye, Xinyu Mou, Dongsheng Liu, Xiaohan Wang, Mengqi Zhang
papers.affiliations: 1 New Laboratory of Pattern Recognition (NLPR), State Key Laboratory of Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Systems (MAIS), Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences 2 Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications 3 School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences 4 School of Advanced Interdisciplinary Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences 5 Huazhong University of Science and Technology 6 Shandong University
papers.intro: 本文识别了多模态知识编辑后的实体身份混淆现象，通过构建诊断基准EC-Bench揭示了其根本原因（编辑方法混淆了I-E绑定与E-E关系知识），并提出通过限制编辑影响I-E处理阶段来缓解该问题，为忠实多模态知识编辑提供了方法论指导。

papers.title: Metonymy in vision models undermines attention-based interpretability
papers.authors: Ananthu Aniraj, Cassio F. Dantas, Dino Ienco, Massimiliano Mancini, Diego Marcos
papers.affiliations: 1. Inria, EVERGREEN, University of Montpellier, France 2. INRAE, UMR TETIS, University of Montpellier, France 3. University of Trento, Italy
papers.intro: 本文揭示了现代视觉模型（尤其是自监督ViT）中普遍存在的对象内部信息泄漏（visual metonymy），并证明这种泄漏破坏了基于注意力机制的可解释性，同时提出了一种两阶段Transformer架构通过设计避免泄漏，从而提升部件发现的忠实性。

papers.title: Boosting Self-Supervised Tracking with Contextual Prompts and Noise Learning
papers.authors: Yaozong Zheng, Qihua Liang, Bineng Zhong, Shuimu Zeng, Yuanliang Xue, Ning Li, Shuxiang Song
papers.affiliations: 广西师范大学（教育部教育区块链与智能技术重点实验室 / 教育智能技术大学工程研究中心） 南安普顿大学 西安高技术研究所
papers.intro: 本文提出PNTrack框架，通过双模态上下文关联机制（语义提示+噪声扰动）在自监督跟踪中按易到难渐进学习鲁棒的跟踪表示，实现了在多个基准上的最优性能。

papers.title: OpenGaFF: Open-Vocabulary Gaussian Feature Field with Codebook Attention
papers.authors: Kunyi Li, Michael Niemeyer, Sen Wang, Stefano Gasperini, Nassir Navab, Federico Tombari
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Munich, Google, Munich Center for Machine Learning, Visualais
papers.intro: OpenGaFF提出一个基于3D高斯泼溅的框架，通过引入高斯特征场和结构化码本注意力机制，在保持几何-语义强耦合的同时实现对象级一致性的开放词汇3D场景理解。

papers.title: AMIEOD: Adaptive Multi-Experts Image Enhancement for Object Detection in Low-Illumination Scenes
papers.authors: Xiaochen Huang, Honggang Chen, Weicheng Zhang, Xiaobo Dai, Yongyi Li, Linbo Qing, Xiaohai He
papers.affiliations: 四川大学电子信息学院（College of Electronics and Information Engineering, Sichuan University）
papers.intro: 提出AMIEOD框架，通过多专家图像增强模块（MEIEM）、检测引导回归损失（DGRL）和专家选择模块（ESM），自适应地选择最优增强策略以提升低光照目标检测精度。

papers.title: Revisiting Uncertainty: On Evidential Learning for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Jun Li, Peifeng Lai, Xuhang Lou, Jinpeng Wang, Yuting Wang, Ke Chen, Yaowei Wang, Shu-Tao Xia
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School; Peng Cheng Laboratory; Harbin Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 一、论文基本信息

papers.title: MSD-Score: Multi-Scale Distributional Scoring for Reference-Free Image Caption Evaluation
papers.authors: Shichao Kan, Xuyang Zhang, Haojie Zhang, Zhe Zhu, Yigang Cen, Yixiong Liang, Lianlei Shan, Linna Zhang, Zhe Qu, Jiazhi Xia
papers.affiliations: Central South University, Beijing Jiaotong University, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Guizhou University
papers.intro: 本文提出MSD-Score，通过将图像块和文本令牌嵌入建模为单位超球面上的von Mises-Fisher混合分布，并使用多尺度分布对齐（双向KL散度与全局相似性的不确定性感知融合）实现无参考图像描述评估，在多个基准上取得与人类判断的领先相关性。

papers.title: Arena as Offline Reward: Efficient Fine-Grained Preference Optimization for Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Zhikai Li, Yue Zhao, Edward Zhongwei Zhang, Xuewen Liu, Jing Zhang, Qingyi Gu, Zhen Dong
papers.affiliations: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of California, Berkeley; University of California, Santa Barbara
papers.intro: 本文提出ArenaPO，通过构建模型竞技场并利用截断正态分布推断图像对之间的绝对质量差距，在无需奖励模型的情况下为DPO提供离线细粒度奖励，实现高效且精细的偏好对齐。

papers.title: PersonaGesture: Single-Reference Co-Speech Gesture Personalization for Unseen Speakers
papers.authors: Xiangyue Zhang, Yiyi Cai, Kunhang Li, Kaixing Yang, You Zhou, Zhengqing Li, Xuangeng Chu, Jiaxu Zhang, Haiyang Liu
papers.affiliations: The University of Tokyo; Shanda AI Research Tokyo; Nanyang Technological University; Renmin University
papers.intro: 提出一种基于扩散的流水线PersonaGesture，通过自适应风格注入（ASI）和隐式分布校正（IDR），从单个参考片段为未见说话人实现无参数更新的协同语音手势个性化。

papers.title: Towards Self-Explainable Document Visual Question Answering with Chain-of-Explanation Predictions
papers.authors: Kjetil Indrehus, Adrian Duric, Changkyu Choi, Ali Ramezani-Kebrya
papers.affiliations: Department of Informatics, University of Oslo; Integreat – Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning; TRUST – The Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI
papers.intro: 提出CoExVQA，一种通过“链式解释”设计（证据选择→答案定位→仅从定位区域解码）实现自解释文档视觉问答的框架，在PFL-DocVQA上达到可解释方法的最佳性能，并提升了预测的透明性与可验证性。

papers.title: RealCam: Real-Time Novel-View Video Generation with Interactive Camera Control
papers.authors: Youcan Xu, Jiaxin Shi, Zhen Wang, Wensong Song, Feifei Shao, Chen Liang, Jun Xiao, Long Chen
papers.affiliations: Youcan Xu, Wensong Song, Feifei Shao, Jun Xiao 来自浙江大学；Jiaxin Shi, Chen Liang 来自 Xmax.AI Ltd.；Zhen Wang, Long Chen 来自香港科技大学
papers.intro: RealCam提出首个自回归框架，通过跨帧上下文学习训练教师模型，再经自强制蒸馏与闭环数据增强得到少步因果学生模型，实现了实时、交互式的相机控制视频生成，在保真度和时序一致性上达到最优且推理速度快数个数量级。

papers.title: Fusion in Your Way: Aligning Image Fusion with Heterogeneous Demands via Direct Preference Optimization
papers.authors: Weijian Su, Songqian Zhang, Yuqi Han, Jian Zhuang, Yongdong Huang, Qiang Zhang
papers.affiliations: 大连理工大学计算机科学与技术学院；社会计算与认知智能教育部重点实验室（大连理工大学）；北方民族大学图像处理与理解研究所
papers.intro: 提出DPOFusion框架，结合属性对齐潜在扩散模型（PALDM）和偏好可控潜在扩散模型（PCLDM），通过实例直接偏好优化（IDPO）实现红外与可见光图像的异构偏好自适应融合，同时支持人类视觉、视觉语言模型和下游任务的偏好对齐。

papers.title: Domain Generalization through Spatial Relation Induction over Visual Primitives
papers.authors: Dat Nguyen, Duc-Duy Nguyen
papers.affiliations: Harvard University, Basis Research Institute; Hanoi University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出PARSE框架，通过将视觉识别分解为可学习的视觉基元及其空间关系（使用可微的二元、三元和四元谓词），并端到端学习基元检测器和类特定结构组合，显著提升域泛化分类性能。

papers.title: PlotPick: AI-powered batch extraction of numerical data from scientific figures
papers.authors: Tommy Carstensen
papers.affiliations: Copenhagen Research Centre for Biological and Precision Psychiatry, Mental Health Centre Copenhagen, Copenhagen University Hospital, Copenhagen, Denmark
papers.intro: PlotPick是一个开源工具，利用通用视觉语言模型（VLM）从科学图表中批量提取结构化表格数据，无需训练或手动标注，在ChartX和PlotQA基准上全面超越专用模型DePlot，且泛化性更强。

papers.title: T2I-VeRW: Part-level Fine-grained Perception for Text-to-Image Vehicle Retrieval
papers.authors: Xiao Wang, Ziwen Wang, Weizhe Kong, Wentao Wu, Yuehang Li, Aihua Zheng, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang
papers.affiliations: 安徽大学计算机科学与技术学院（Ziwen Wang, Yuehang Li, Xiao Wang, Jin Tang）；安徽大学人工智能学院（Weizhe Kong, Wentao Wu, Aihua Zheng, Chenglong Li）
papers.intro: 本文提出PFCVR模型，通过部件级局部细粒度对齐模块和双向掩码恢复隐式对齐模块，并结合新建的大规模数据集T2I-VeRW，在文本到图像车辆检索任务上显著超越现有方法。

papers.title: Adding Thermal Awareness to Visual Systems in Real-Time via Distilled Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Yuchen Guo, Junli Gong, Wenjun Dong, Yiuming Cheung, Weifeng Su
papers.affiliations: ¹ Northwestern University, ² Northeastern University, ³ Hong Kong Baptist University, ⁴ Beijing Normal - Hong Kong Baptist University
papers.intro: 提出FusionProxy，通过从两个扩散融合教师模型（DDFM和Mask-DiFuser）的样本集成中蒸馏出轻量级单步学生网络，在保持扩散级融合质量的同时实现实时推理，且作为即插即用模块可直接接入任何预训练的RGB下游模型。

papers.title: 4DThinker: Thinking with 4D Imagery for Dynamic Spatial Understanding
papers.authors: Zhangquan Chen, Manyuan Zhang, Xinlei Yu, Xiang An, Bo Li, Xin Xie, ZiDong Wang, Mingze Sun, Shuang Chen, Hongyu Li, Xiaobin Hu, Ruqi Huang
papers.affiliations: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院、香港中文大学、新加坡国立大学、LMMs-Lab、加州大学洛杉矶分校
papers.intro: 本文提出4DThinker，首个通过动态潜在心理想象（latent mental imagery）使VLM在隐藏空间中内部模拟4D时空演变的框架，无需外部几何模块即可完成单目视频的动态空间推理。

papers.title: Prompt-Free and Efficient SAM2 Adaptation for Biomedical Semantic Segmentation via Dual Adapters
papers.authors: Hinako Mitsuoka, Kazuhiro Hotta
papers.affiliations: Meijo University, Nagoya, Japan
papers.intro: 提出一种无提示、参数高效的SAM2微调框架，通过卷积位置编码生成器（PEG）适应任意分辨率，并设计双适配器（高性能HP适配器与轻量LW适配器）在保持低推理开销的同时大幅提升生物医学分割精度。
